Warm lit key planes and strong directional cyan back-right rim give edge-band luminance >=0.27 against basalt 0.16; no uniform outline. Native raster at least 1536 square, full character occupies 84% height, for >=1024 master and 512 export. Do not imitate hidden RGB colors in transparent references.
